summary.name: Claid AI
summary.one_liner: Claid is an AI product and fashion photo editor that turns simple product shots into studio-style images with realistic backgrounds, AI models, and clean cutouts.
use_cases: Creating studio-quality product photos from simple shots
Generating on-model fashion photos with diverse AI models
Removing or replacing product backgrounds for catalogs and ads
Bulk editing and resizing product images via API
Meeting marketplace image requirements for seller onboarding
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Claid as a photo suite for product and fashion imagery. It offers AI-generated realistic backgrounds with natural lighting and shadows, diverse AI fashion models, and cutouts that aim to preserve textures, labels, and fine detail, with output up to native 4K. Enhancement tools cover sharpening, color fixing, and high-resolution output. Background tools remove backgrounds or generate scenes, and an API automates editing for large catalogs, including checking and editing images to platform requirements and replicating brand backgrounds. The page says there is a free option to try, and mentions a claid studio with 10+ additional tools.
notable: Generates on-model fashion photos with diverse AI models
Native 4K output with realistic lighting and shadows
API for bulk catalog editing and brand-style replication
caveats: Page says it is free to try but does not detail free-tier limits or paid plan prices
Customer testimonials and claimed metrics (e.g., 80% cost reduction) are marketing claims, not independently verified
